description: Use this when the user asks what sheets or columns a spreadsheet has, how many rows it has, or how many pages it would print before making a PDF. Takes the same file or CSV text, sheet, columns and layout options as sheet_to_pdf and returns the sheets (with hidden ones marked), the header row, row and column counts, empty and widest columns, formula cells without a saved result, a 5-row preview and the page estimate for the chosen layout. Does not make a file and does not change the sheet.

columns.description: Print only these columns, in this order, by header name or column letter, e.g. ["Name", "Email", "Total"]. Default: all columns.

csv_text.description: Instead of a file: the table as CSV text with a header row, e.g. "Name,Qty\nApples,3\nPears,5". Use either file or csv_text.

delimiter.description: For CSV text: the separator, e.g. semicolon. Default: detected from the file.

file.description: The sheet to print: a CSV, TSV or Excel .xlsx file, e.g. inventory.xlsx or contacts.csv.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

fit_width.description: true (default): when columns are too wide, the font gets smaller (down to 7 pt) before cells wrap. false: keep font_size and wrap cell text.

font_size.description: Font size in points from 7 to 12, e.g. 9 (default).

has_header.description: true (default): the first non-empty row is the header row (one-cell title rows above it are printed as the title). false: columns are named Column A, Column B, ...

header_row.description: The sheet row (or CSV line) number that holds the header, e.g. 3 when rows 1-2 hold a title. Rows above it are left out. Default: detected.

include_hidden.description: For .xlsx: true also prints hidden rows and columns. Default false (as Excel prints).

orientation.description: Page orientation, e.g. landscape. auto (default) picks portrait when the columns fit, else landscape.

page_numbers.description: true (default) prints Page 1 of N in each page footer.

paper.description: Paper size, e.g. a4. Default letter.

row_numbers.description: true adds a # column with row numbers 1, 2, 3. Default false.

sheet.description: For .xlsx: the sheet name to print, e.g. "Q3 Sales". Default: the first visible sheet.

title.description: Optional title above the table on page 1, up to 120 characters, e.g. "Inventory, November 2026".

name: inspect_sheet
title: Inspect a sheet
